answer: Re-attestations are stored in beacon and opal lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 20 epochs, so holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the inlet graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 254 impostors cost 309 times the honest price and take 10 times as long to clear. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
